name: omniroute
description: Unified AI router with 160+ providers, RTK+Caveman compression, auto fallback, MCP/A2A, desktop, PWA, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
author: diegosouzapw

scripts.check:docs-all: bun run check:docs-sync && bun run check:docs-counts && bun run check:env-doc-sync && bun run check:deprecated-versions && bun run check:doc-links && bun run check:fabricated-docs
scripts.quality:gate: bun run quality:collect && bun run quality:ratchet -- --allow-missing
scripts.audit:deps: bun audit --audit-level=critical && (bun audit --audit-level=high || echo '::warning::high-severity advisories present (non-blocking)')
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env DISABLE_SQLITE_AUTO_BACKUP=true NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 c8 --merge-async --output-dir coverage --exclude=tests/** --exclude=**/*.test.* --reporter=text-summary --reporter=html --reporter=json-summary --reporter=lcov --check-coverage --statements 60 --lines 60 --functions 60 --branches 60 bun run test:coverage:runner
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit && bun run test:vitest && bun run test:vitest:ui && bun run test:ecosystem && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build:cli-api && bun run build:cli && bun run check:pack-artifact
